subject: Hosted API costing + model lineup — quick inbound from Olive Health
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@olivehealth.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@procure.olivehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Costing and model lineup for hosted API - quick ask

Hi Monica,

Quick intro — I’m Alice, Head of AI Products at Olive Health. We’re evaluating hosted LLM providers for a clinical-doc summarization pilot and have a short vendor RFP attached (OliveHealth_RFP_Q2.pdf). Before we book a demo, could you send the following baseline details so we can include them in our procurement comparison: 

- Standard per-1M token pricing split (input vs output) for your hosted API (list the typical models you expose and the IO split if different per model)
- Streaming vs non-streaming pricing (are there separate rates or the same IO accounting?)
- Any available volume-commit discount tiers (examples at 500k / 1M / 5M tokens per month) and whether minimum term applies
- Are embeddings billed differently? If so, provide per-1M rates (or point us to the ratecard)
- Any sample latency guidance for short chat-style requests (<=512 tokens) on hosted endpoints

Also cc’ing procurement — Sam — who’s capturing pricing for our RFP. We’d appreciate a short PDF rate sheet if you have one.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Head of AI Products, Olive Health
Alice.Nguyen@olivehealth.com

Attachment: OliveHealth_RFP_Q2.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@procure.olivehealth.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-06-30T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Costing and model lineup for hosted API - quick ask

Hi Alice — great to meet you, and thanks for the RFP. I’m copying Neha (pricing) to make sure we cover the details you asked for. I attached our hosted ratecard (Redwood-hosted-ratecard-v1.pdf) — below is a concise baseline so you can drop it into your RFP table quickly. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if you want to walk through lanes.

Baseline hosted (per 1M tokens) — input / output:
- redwood-3.5: $400 input / $800 output
- redwood-7b: $600 input / $1,200 output
- redwood-13b: $1,000 input / $2,000 output
- redwood-70b: $2,500 input / $5,000 output

Notes:
- Embeddings: $1,200 per 1M embedding tokens (separate SKU)
- Streaming: charged by same IO accounting as above; streaming has no extra per-connection fee (tokens billed as emitted)
- Latency guidance (hosted, p95, single-request, 512 tokens): redwood-7b ~120–200ms per-token generation latency; redwood-13b ~180–350ms per-token depending on sequence; we’ll share region-specific traces on request

Volume discounts (hosted API committed monthly via MRR contract):
- 500k/mo: 10% off baseline
- 1M/mo: 18% off baseline
- 5M+ / enterprise: negotiate (typically 25–40% depending on term & support)

Open items:
- Security/compliance profile (SOC2 audit artifacts) — Neha will follow up with our security packet.
- If you expect heavy short-turnaround low-latency needs we can propose a Dedicated pool (different commercial model).

Would you like a short call tomorrow (Thu) or Friday to run through the RFP items?

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0148

Attachment: Redwood-hosted-ratecard-v1.pdf

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@olivehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@procure.olivehealth.com>
Date: 2027-07-01T08:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Costing and model lineup for hosted API - quick ask

Thanks Monica — that’s exactly what we needed for the RFP table. A couple of follow-ups from procurement: 

- We’re budgeting a 12-month pilot at ~1M tokens/month. That 18% tier looks promising — can you confirm whether the discount applies to both input and output line items equally?
- Does the 1M tier require prepayment or an MRR commit? We prefer a monthly invoice with a committed minimum rather than prepaying.
- For embeddings at $1,200/1M, do you have any guidance on typical embed token usage per document? (E.g., 1,000 clinical notes ~ estimated tokens?)

Also, on the security piece — we’ll need SOC2 Type II evidence and a data processing addendum. If Neha can send those artifacts, we’ll include them with the RFP response.

If you can confirm the above by EOD, we’ll insert the numbers and proceed to vendor scoring.

—Alice

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@olivehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-01T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Costing and model lineup for hosted API - quick ask

Hi Alice — looping in on the commercial specifics. Quick answers: 

- Yes — the vacancy discounts apply equally to input and output tokens on hosted SKUs (we apply the percentage at invoice time across token line items).
- 1M/mo tier: we can do a 12-month MRR commit (monthly invoiced) with an 18% discount; no prepayment required. The contract will include a minimum monthly billing floor.
- Embeddings consumption: rough rule-of-thumb — a single clinical note (avg. 600–1,200 words) typically maps to ~800–3,000 tokens depending on tokenization and markup. If you share sample docs we can run a quick tokenization estimate.

If you’re comfortable with the 12-month committed MRR approach, I can put together a simple term sheet (SOW + MSA redline-ready) and send to Sam/procurement. For pilots we sometimes add a one-time onboarding credit (small $ credit) to offset initial usage; we can include that in the term sheet as an incentive.

Proposed next steps:
- Monica: schedule 30-min call this week to confirm model selection for pilot and scope;
- Neha: send SOC2 Type II package + DPA;
- I’ll draft a term sheet with the 1M/mo 12-month MRR commit (18% off) and optional onboarding credit.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Monica
